title: Enforceable bounded receive and storage primitive for task-sync fetch (quarantine repository with transfer/history/disk budget)
outcome: Enforceable bounded receive and storage primitive for task-sync fetch (quarantine repository with transfer/history/disk budget)
acceptance: Automated fetch receives into an isolated operation-owned quarantine object repository under the configured Git-admin area, never writing unvalidated incoming packs into the selected repository, with no shallow, filter, alternates or promisor bypass and no auto-GC or network under a database transaction

A finite admission budget is ENFORCED, not merely measured: received protocol bytes, object and commit counts plus maximum ancestry traversal, per-object decoded size and aggregate selected-task bytes, total operation disk bytes including partial pack, index, temp and journal, and project-wide unresolved-operation count and retained bytes; a resumed transfer keeps its consumed budget

Enforcement is either a metered receive path with hard storage enforcement for every subprocess write, or an owned bounded receive/index pipeline whose writes are all accounted before publication; plain fetch plus timeout, directory polling, deleting after an oversized pack, or index-pack --max-input-size alone do not satisfy this

Each supported platform has an identified mechanism and tests; an unsupported platform or budget refuses automatic fetch before any network access, and oversized history yields a bounded refusal, never a truncated graph
